why_trail.why: Both missions are one-line guard hardenings against the same defect family (a check that cannot fail in the healthy-only world). #488: resolve_gauge_path in scripts/hooks/gauge_writer_hook.py:257-264 appends one candidate per binding with no dedup, so two bindings resolving to one gauge path (the live Admiral db1a42c1 shape: epic-418-redux/spine.json + latitude-interrogation.json, both parent .agent-work/epic-418-redux/) trip the caller's 2+-candidates ambiguous-binding skip even though there is no misattribution risk when both point at the same file. Fix: dedup candidates by distinct Path in resolve_gauge_path; keep the different-path case skipping (do not touch handle_post_tool_use's len>1 check or checklist_engine.py, fenced to #465). #489: tests/test_verify_spec_confirmed.py:252 takes matches[0] from a glob with no signal a 2nd match existed -- fix by extracting a helper that raises naming every match on 2+, using tmp_path fixtures only (never mutating the live .agent-work/epic-418-redux tree). Both: build the defective world, observe current code wrong, paste it, then fix, then observe right.

Fixed resolve_gauge_path to dedup candidates by distinct Path (order-preserving, first-seen wins). Same-work-dir Admiral shape (spine.json + latitude-interrogation.json) now resolves to exactly one candidate -> a real gauge.json reading via handle_post_tool_use. Genuinely different work dirs still yield 2 distinct candidates -> ambiguous-binding skip fires exactly as before (#261 unweakened). No change to handle_post_tool_use's len>1 check, checklist_engine.py, or the binding key shape.

Extracted _resolve_revised_spec_matches(agent_work_root) in tests/test_verify_spec_confirmed.py: returns the sorted match list unchanged on 0 or 1, raises AssertionError naming every match on 2+. _fixture now delegates to it, preserving the skipTest-on-zero behaviour. Added tests for zero/one/two/three-match cases (tmp_path fixtures only, never touching the real .agent-work/epic-418-redux tree). All 26 tests pass, including the 2 pre-existing live-regression tests against the real one-match fixture -- unaffected.

Continuation session ran the full suite with a captured real exit code (1789 passed, 2 skipped, 683 subtests, exit 0 via echo EXIT_CODE=$? -- not a pipe), fast-forwarded the branch to origin/main (it had zero commits of its own), committed both fixes plus notes/plan artifacts, pushed epic-418/w3c-488-489, opened PR #491 with -F against the pr-body.md file (verified 37-line body posted intact, no truncation), and wrote IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.md with before/after evidence for both missions and the isolation proof.
